property: For every completed range read, each returned log identity and payload equals the requested immutable record; valid prewritten records do not produce decode/EOF errors due to other readers.
method: Compare (term,index,payload) tuples against an independent prewritten input table. On immutable valid data, unexpected decoding error/panic is a violation after harness causes are excluded.
witness_requirements: Requested range, exact stored input, returned identity/bytes, file identity, both reader operations and their causal overlap.
